enchantment.jem_world_boss_tiers.progres: Applied only from a book through an anvil. Evolves compatible vanilla and modded weapons, tools, and armor through World Tier III. Equipment keeps normal durability, Mending, and Unbreaking, but cannot be lost to fire, despawn, or the void. Tier III to IV and IV to V add no further power.
tooltip.jem_world_boss_tiers.progression: Progression I, World Tier I: ready to evolve. Normal durability; protected from accidental loss.
Progression I, World Tier II: +5%% weapon damage, +1 melee damage, +5%% native attack speed, faster ranged use, arrow piercing II.
Progression I, World Tier III or higher: +10%% weapon damage, +2 melee damage, +10%% native attack speed, 15%% weapon crit, arrow piercing III.
Progression I, World Tier I: armor is ready to evolve. Normal durability; protected from accidental loss.
Progression I, World Tier II: +5%% armor stats. Helmet resists projectiles; chest resists heavy hits; leggings grant Speed; boots resist falls and knockback.

Progression I, World Tier III or higher: +10%% armor stats. Projectile reflection; chest guard against hits of at least 8 damage before armor (35%%, 1/100 Minecraft-day cooldown); Speed II and attack speed; stronger fall and knockback protection.
